Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Security
Sponsor: Pettus
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 02/09/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 112 as introduced authorizes the Alabama Fire College to certify peer support members, which would increase the obligations of the College by an estimated $55,000 annually to reimburse travel expenses for certified peer support counselors.
Allen Treadaway, Chair
Public Safety and Homeland Security
